text_block_list.text:
...And so, on that day, I brought Narita Brian with me
to Hanshin Racecourse to watch Biwa Hayahide's Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You'd better have meant what you said this morning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Playing dumb won't work on me.
We've come this far; I won't let you renege on our agreement.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... You really are persistent!!
What obligation do I have to follow you around?!
choice_data_list: Because I absolutely need you to be here!
Because I really wanted you to see this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then promise me that if I come, you'll never involve yourself with me again.
No, that's not enough. Surrender your Trainer badge, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

...Regardless, I managed to get her here.
All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Up next is the Junior Class Make Debut!
Who will seize victory today?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...She's about to make her move.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (...Are you watching, Brian?)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(You loved running, and chasing down rivals, more than anyone.
That is why you naturally sought out someone who could match your stride.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Yet you were far too strong. Your expectations were routinely shattered.
And that experience... gave you the terrible habit of giving up on others.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(But listen, Brian. You must realize this:
the rivals you seek can also be born from those you turned your back on—the defeated!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide takes the lead! She's completely broken away!
The margin is two lengths, no, three... What a blowout! A dominant victory!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What was that...?! Since when could she run like that...?!
With eyes like a predator stalking its prey, fixed solely on the finish line—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sister! Why did you hide that thrilling stride from me until now?!
Why didn't you ever invite me to race against you?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So you came, Brian.
...And you as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we head up to the stands together?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm talking to you right—
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ngh?! What's with this cheering...?
It's even louder than Sister's race...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Mine was merely a Make Debut race, after all.
It pales in comparison to the Main Race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do not underestimate them, Brian.
There are runners here far beyond my current level.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And here we are, today's Main Race!
The pack is tightly bunched up front. Who will break away for the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian, who do you think will win this race?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Don't care. Doesn't matter to me.
More importantly, I want to race you, Sister—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I believe she will win.

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...! That voice—

text_block_list.name: Senior Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I haven't won anything yet...! Someone like me... has no right
to think she can even compete with a monster like that...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...No way. Is that the girl from before...?
She never had that kind of tenacity. No, she didn't even have that sheer hunger for victory...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She told me... 'Even if I can't reach her now, I will defeat her.'
She vowed to reforge herself and stand on the very same stage as you one day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That is why you must first win this race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Brian, this is the Twinkle Series.
A place where everyone struggles to the bitter end just to reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Come, Brian. Ascend to this world.
Right now, you haven't even made it to the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I promise I will be there to face you.
On the grandest stage of all—the GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

She swallowed hard.
Yet even that sound was—
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHHH!!)

Completely drowned out by the roar of the Twinkle Series.
A roar powerful enough to seize hold of her very soul.
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to run out there too?
...Do you want to run out there too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Like hell you need to ask...! ...Tch!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'm changing the terms of our deal from this morning.
You can stay a Trainer. But in exchange—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Become MY Trainer.
And take me all the way to the Twinkle Series...!!
—A few days after that momentous day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Brian. What race are you entering next?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Don't see how that's any of your business.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's totally my business, moron. I'm gonna train like hell till then.
Just so I can crush you into dust.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A real one-on-one only ends when one of us hits the dirt.
I ain't down yet... so don't you dare go ending this on your own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Haha! Right, I see. I underestimated this place.
So this is Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. I'll blow past every single one of them.
Let's move, Trainer...!
